m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12887028 by mexicanhere; English translation #7249671 by aizuddineismail

m.t: Tom y María nunca fueron amigos cercanos.
m.e: Tom and Mary have never been close friends.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4631654 by AucaCoyan; English translation #4630747 by CK

m.t: Tom tiene apenas amigos cercanos.
m.e: Tom has hardly any close friends.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5217066 by Elyte; English translation #5216773 by CK

m.t: Fueron a trabajar a los campos cercanos.
m.e: They went to work in nearby fields.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12145065 by carlosalberto; English translation #12145009 by carlosalberto

m.t: Bueno, eso significa que debe de ser en uno de esos cuatro edificios cercanos al río.
m.e: Well, that means he must be in one of these four buildings near the river.

m.t: Y sé que nos hemos vuelto cercanos demasiado rápido.
m.e: And I know that we got close really quick.

m.t: Después de que tu madre murió, tu padre y yo nos volvimos cercanos.
m.e: After your mother died, your father and I became close.

m.t: Los que eran cercanos a ti, tal vez pudieron compartir una cama.
m.e: The ones who were close to you, maybe shared a bed.

m.t: Solo la comparto con mis amigos más cercanos.
m.e: I only share with my closest friends.

m.t: Sé que usted y el general Ludendorff son... muy cercanos.
m.e: I know you and General Ludendorff are... very close.

m.t: ¿Ud. y su hermano eran cercanos?
m.e: Were you and your brother close?

m.t: ¿Quiénes son tus amigos más cercanos?
m.e: Who are your closest friends?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1478651 by marcelostockle; English translation #1747578 by belgavox

m.t: Tom y yo éramos cercanos.
m.e: Tom and I were close.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8769657 by SemperAutumnus; English translation #6274336 by CK

m.t: Tom y Mary son muy cercanos.
m.e: Tom and Mary are extremely close.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5714170 by arh; English translation #5700083 by CK
